sources.title: deepbeepmeep/Wan2GP | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: WanGP is a comprehensive AI-powered video, image, and audio generation platform designed to make state-of-the-art generative models accessible with minimal hardware requirements. It specializes in optimizing large models (like Wan 2.1, Hunyuan Video, and Flux) for "GPU poor" environments, enabling high-quality generation on consumer hardware.
